mutation: Fixed Step 2 FIFO P&L calculation — the current logic incorrectly ignores `cashPnl` on partially-closed positions (only counting it when `size == 0`), causing mathematically wrong totals in all scenarios with mixed open/partial-close positions.

Added explicit closed-position handling — when `size == 0`, skip the CLOB midpoint query and set `current_price=0`, `current_value=0`, `unrealized_pnl=0`, `unrealized_pnl_pct=0` in the export, preventing division-by-zero and ensuring the export is structurally complete for all position states.
